chunks: Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb asked him, saying:
"Is what is forbidden for me in the sanctuary of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم the same as what is forbidden for me in the sanctuary of Allah, the Exalted?" He said: "No."

key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.يَحْرُمُ: becomes forbidden or prohibited in legal context

ai.seo_question: Are the same prohibitions of the Haram of Allah applied in the Haram of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith records Yūnus ibn Yaʿqūb asking whether the prohibitions that apply in the sanctuary of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم are identical to those of the sanctuary of Allah. The Imam عليه السلام replies in the negative, indicating a legal distinction between the two sanctuaries.
